title: Jonah and the Alibi
author: Noor Hartwell
blurb: Wren Halloran, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
